theme.description: High-density precision engineering B2B trade management application for Pergola, Awnings (Tente), Bioclimatic Aluminum Systems, and Glass facades export pipelines. Dark obsidian slate command palette with high-visibility signal accents (International Safety Orange/Amber for status, Precision Cobalt for actions, Emerald for financial clearance and customs clearance).

entry_surfaces./: split layout: left side hero architectural Pergola/Glass system visual with live pipeline statistics ribbon, right side Turkish trade enterprise login & quick-demo toggle panel
entry_surfaces./login: split hero — architectural Pergola & Tente export positioning panel left, high-security email+password auth form right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: command center dashboard with 5-KPI financial & operational header, 11-stage pipeline distribution bar, active export projects table, and logistics dispatch summary
entry_surfaces./projects: dense multi-filter project registry with 11-stage filter chips, dealer country tags, export currency badges, and modal for creating new pergola/glass orders
entry_surfaces./projects/:id: high-precision project detail console with 11-stage horizontal stepper, product specs (kalemler) CRUD table, multi-currency accounting & 5-installment ledger, crate packing (sandık) logistics planner, and activity log
entry_surfaces./reports/daily: daily export & production report cockpit with date navigation picker, stage transition ledger, revenue & profit cards, and direct openpyxl / xlsx export action
entry_surfaces./dealers: domestic and overseas dealer directory with credit status, country, open orders, and trade history

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Application Language: Turkish (Türkçe) UI terminology as specified in the original prompt (e.g. 'Proforma', 'Revizyon', 'Bioklimatik Pergola', 'Sürme Cam', 'Giyotin Cam', 'Sandık Listesi', 'İhraç Kayıtlı Fatura', 'Gümrük Beyannamesi', '5 Taksit Tahsilat').
2. Template: farm-ts (FastAPI in backend/ + Vite React 19 in frontend/). All API requests use typed helper in frontend/src/lib/api.ts.
3. Implement full 11-stage workflow state machine in Python backend and React frontend. When a stage is updated, automatically log a record to project activity timeline with timestamp.

4. Project Items (Kalemler) Table must feature structured fields: Ürün Tipi (Select), Adet (Qty), Genişlik (Width cm), Açılım (Projection cm), Alüminyum RAL Kodu (Select/Input), Cam Kombinasyonu (Select), LED Aydınlatma (Select), Kumaş/Zip (Select), Motor & Kumanda, Tedarikçi Firma, Birim Fiyat, Toplam Tutar.

5. Accounting & Installment Module: Provide instant calculations for Satış, İskonto (%), Net Satış, Tedarikçi Alış Maliyeti, Gümrük/Transfer Masrafları, Net Kar, Kar Marjı (%), and an interactive 5-installment schedule (Taksit 1..5: Vade, Tutar, Durum, Tahsilat Tarihi, Not) that calculates Toplam Tahsil Edilen vs Kalan Bakiye.

6. Packing & Logistics Module: Sandık / Paket listesi table with columns for Sandık No, En (cm), Boy (cm), Yükseklik (cm), Adet, Toplam m³ (CBM calculated automatically), Brüt Kilo (Kg), Tedarikçi, Lojistik Firması, Rezervasyon No, Tır/Konteyner No, Yükleme Tarihi.

7. Daily Report Page (/reports/daily): Date-picker navigation, summary of orders moved between stages on the selected date, financial summary, and an 'Excel (.xlsx) İndir' button powered by backend openpyxl / pandas export.

8. Seed Data: Create rich realistic Turkish export data in backend/seed.py (at least 8-10 realistic projects across different countries like Almanya, Fransa, İngiltere, Hollanda, BAE, Irak, and domestic Türkiye dealers) with full specs, crates, 5-stage installments, and timelines.
9. Auth: Clean Turkish login / demo toggle with JWT session cookies so the user can easily switch and test all team features.
